pages.text: The Fluid Grid is a specialized interface for viewing and managing fluids in your storage network. It provides a user interface to access all fluids stored in your network.

Features:$(li)View all fluids in your storage network$(li)Search and filter fluids$(li)Sort fluids by name, quantity, or ID$(li)Group similar fluids together$(li)Use Grid Filters to create custom views$(li)View fluid amounts and storage tanks

To use the Fluid Grid:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Right-click to open the interface$(li)Use the search bar to find fluids$(li)Click fluids to extract them$(li)Use Grid Filters to customize your view
